title: The Light detail budget makes room for the town's windows
items: Nothing you can see changes in the town. Light is the setting weaker machines start on, and on a desktop screen it had gone over its triangle budget once every 1835 building got windows, doors and trim and the signs got chains.
With the owner's go-ahead, Light's budget now matches what the town draws from the busiest view on the West prairie, plus the same small margin it had before.
On a phone the town still fits inside the old Light budget. The draw-call limit has not moved.
